about: Human judgements of hints, for checking the model grader against people. Copy to labels.json and add real labels; `npm run eval:hints` then grades each labelled hint and reports how often the grader agrees. caseId is an id from cases.ts; hintNumber is 1 to 5; hint is the exact text judged; label is good or bad. criteria, labeller and note are optional and are not used by the script yet.
